followup.completion_standard: A successful result must include verifiable source records with SAMM50-specific perturbation scope and measured MICOS/cristae or quality-control endpoints; generic mitochondrial stress evidence alone is insufficient. stop_reason: Do not stop at a mechanism conclusion: the only successful evidence is the current K562 association, while target identity and primary literature acquisition failed. One bounded provenance/identity followup is justified.
